comment: Written by hand and read by both services: tool-server's masked_writes_test.go and ai-service's test_masked_writes.py. Every value is made up.

cases.name: apply a Secret as it was read

args.yaml_content:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: db
  namespace: shop
  labels:
    tier: edited
data:
  password: <REDACTED:secret>

cases.name: apply a Secret with the placeholder under stringData

args.yaml_content:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: db
  namespace: shop
stringData:
  password: "<REDACTED:secret>"

cases.name: apply a Secret with the placeholder encoded for data

args.yaml_content:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: db
  namespace: shop
data:
  password: PFJFREFDVEVEOnNlY3JldD4=

cases.name: apply a Secret with a placeholder inside an encoded address

args.yaml_content:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: db
  namespace: shop
data:
  url: cG9zdGdyZXM6Ly9hOjxSRURBQ1RFRDpwYXNzd29yZD5AZGIvYXBw

args.yaml_content:

args.yaml_content:

cases.name: apply a ConfigMap whose value was masked by its key's name

args.yaml_content:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: app
  namespace: shop
data:
  db_password: <REDACTED:db_password>

cases.name: apply a Deployment whose env value was masked

args.yaml_content:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
  namespace: shop
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: app
        env:
        - name: DB_PASSWORD
          value: <REDACTED:DB_PASSWORD>

cases.name: a Secret value of four stars, which no screen writes

args.yaml_content:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: db
  namespace: shop
data:
  pattern: KioqKg==
stringData:
  other: '****'

  namespace: shop
